unsupported: Plas-Tech Inc. has operated from Omaha, Nebraska since 1991, when founder Gary Jasek established the state's only low-density polyethylene bag manufacturing facility.
The company produces low-density polyethylene bags, sheets, and tubing (roll stock) through extrusion and converting processes.

Jasek founded the business to provide a level of product quality and service that he felt was unavailable elsewhere in Nebraska, emphasizing competitive pricing and direct access to the owner-operator's technical expertise.
